:### Okay so this is very good but honestly I still have basically zero comprehension of what is going on here. Like what decision even is there to make here?
:### Plain version: there is '''no decision'''. These 8 pages are leftover worksheets from an old cleanup. Back then, two different wiki categories each claimed the same Wikidata item (usually an English name vs a differently-cased duplicate), and the bot made one worksheet per conflict listing both claimants so someone could pick the survivor. Since then, the losing category in every one of these 8 conflicts was deleted by normal cleanup — so each worksheet now lists only a winner. The pages should just become redirects to their surviving category, and the cleanup bot is supposed to do that itself; it hasn't because of a formatting quirk on the worksheets, which is a bot bug (queued to fix), not a choice for you. Once fixed, all 8 vanish on their own and this whole item closes.
